messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I sketched a small proposal for tightening postmortem follow-ups and making action ownership & timelines visible. TL;DR: 1) single canonical timeline template, 2) explicit owner + due date on every action, 3) weekly remediation review for recurring incidents, 4) formal IC handoff notes for rotations. Open to bikeshedding.

maria: Love this. Can you paste the template inline? Something lightweight so folks actually use it.

alex: Yep — keeping it minimal so it fits in the postmortem doc and in Slack threads. Suggestion below (copy/pasteable).

```
POSTMORTEM FOLLOW-UP TIMELINE (minimal)
- incident_id: <INC-YYYYMMDD-##>
- root_cause_summary: one sentence
- severity: P1/P2

Action items: (one per line)
- [OWNER] - short action title - due: YYYY-MM-DD - status: todo/in-progress/done - notes: <link to PR/doc>

Key dates:
- incident_start: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM
- mitigated: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM
- postmortem_published: YYYY-MM-DD
- follow-up_review: YYYY-MM-DD (scheduled weekly for open actions)

Recurring pattern? yes/no + short evidence
Next review owner: <team or person>
```

kevin: Couple things — (1) add a field for "secondary owner" for cross-team tasks, and (2) we should auto-generate follow-up reminders into #eng-oncall + ping the IC on rotation. Too many actions fall off.

sam: Secondary owner makes sense. Also propose we add a short cadence for communication when follow-ups slip: 1) reminder at T-7 days, 2) escalation to team lead at T+1 day, 3) include in weekly SRE/Platform sync.

jaya: For recurring incidents, can we add a quarterly "incident trends" review that compiles all open actions and identifies repeat root causes? That helps prioritize platform-level fixes vs bandaids.

alex: Good call. My proposal for responsibilities:
- postmortem author: ensures all actions listed and owners assigned within 48h
- owners: mark status updates weekly and close with PR/link
- IC on duty: ensures handoff note when leaving shift, flags any blockers to on-call rotation lead
- on-call rotation lead (monthly role): runs the weekly remediation review and maintains backlog of open actions

maria: How do we enforce owners updating status? I'd prefer lightweight automation over policing.

incident-bot: Reminder: open actions detected in recent postmortems. 5 items without updates >14 days. See https://redwood-internal/pm-actions

jaya: Can the bot attach the minimal template when a postmortem is published? That would save friction.

alex: Agreed. Implementation plan (quick):
- step 1 (owner: alex) — publish the minimal template in the postmortem template and add a checklist item in the PM flow. due: 2026-04-05
- step 2 (owner: kevin) — add secondary_owner field and small GitHub Action that adds follow-up row into remediation tracking sheet. due: 2026-04-12
- step 3 (owner: sam) — update incident-bot to send T-7 and T+1 reminders and tag rotation lead. due: 2026-04-19
- step 4 (owner: jaya) — schedule recurring quarterly "incident trends" review. due: 2026-04-30

kevin: I can take step 2 but will need a short spec for the sheet columns. Proposing: incident_id, action_title, owner, secondary_owner, created, due, status, linked_pr, notes.

sam: I'll add the reminders. Can we make the T-7 reminder configurable per severity? Like skip T-7 for low-impact ops items.

alex: Yes — reminder rules: P1/P2 always, P3 only if due >21 days. I'll add that to the implementation tickets.

maria: Small UX ask: when we tag owners in Slack, append the due date in the message. That reduces back-and-forth.

jaya: Also suggest a simple dashboard tile in the console for "open remediation actions by team" to drive visibility outside #eng-oncall. I can draft a mock.

alex: Proposed operational cadence after implementation:
- within 48h: postmortem published with filled template + owner assignments
- weekly: remediation review in the eng-oncall / SRE sync (rotation lead runs)
- monthly: rotation lead sanity-check + send summary to eng leadership if >5 overdue items
- quarterly: incident trends deep-dive (platform + infra + product reps)

sam: Quick note on IC rotation: let's require a 5–10 minute handoff message when the IC exits shift. Contents: current active mitigations, open follow-ups assigned during the shift, and any blocked owners. We'll add a tiny form to populate this.

kevin: Sounds operationally tractable. If we automate sheet rows + reminders I think completion rate will improve a lot.

maria: +1. I'll volunteer to pilot this for the next P1 postmortem to see friction points.

alex: Awesome — will create the implementation tickets and drop links here. Thanks all.

incident-bot: New ticket created: PM-1043 (add template to postmortem flow) assigned to alex, due 2026-04-05.

sam: Thanks — can you also add a label "remediation-tracking" to postmortem PRs so reviewers check for owners/due dates?

alex: Added to the checklist. We'll iterate after the pilot. :thumbsup:
